youtube_description:
LocalAI v5.0.0 shipped on GitHub on November 18. Its Simple Office add-on gives a chat a way to turn notes in Files into a downloadable Word document. This episode shows where the new workflow fits and what to check before using it.

Start with the v5.0.0 release, a locally hosted model that can use tools and Simple Office. Upload invented notes to Files, ask for a one-page Word summary and compare the .docx with the source facts. Desktop builds support Apple silicon and Linux. A Project organizes work and does not enforce a separate permission boundary.

We inspected the MIT-licensed repository, release and docs. We did not run a live model or measure its quality. Follow AI Daily Diff for GitHub releases you can evaluate on a concrete task.
